title: Appearance & Theme
dynamicBackgroundDesc: Enable fluid motion and particle effects. Disable if you experience lag or wish to save battery.
darkModeDesc: Toggle between dark and light appearance. Uses the official SoulBits themes.
followSystemThemeDesc: Automatically switch theme based on system settings
emojiStyleDesc: Choose how emojis look in chat messages
nativeDesc: Use your device's built-in emoji style
twemojiDesc: Clean, flat emoji originally by Twitter/X (CC-BY 4.0)
builtInThemeMessage: Built-in themes cannot be edited. Create a custom theme based on this one?
deleteThemeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
backgroundStyleDesc: Choose an animated background design for the app. Each style responds to the current theme's accent colors.
bgStyleAuroraDesc: Luminous drifting gradient orbs — the signature atmospheric aurora effect.
bgStyleGeodesicDesc: Rotating geodesic sphere wireframes with luminous triangular lattices and glowing vertices.
bgStyleGradientFlowDesc: Multi-layered flowing gradient ribbons with organic motion — like liquid aurora silk.
bgStyleNeuralPulseDesc: Living synaptic network: neurons fire and action potentials travel along glowing dendrites.
